description.zh: 用户编辑的业务知识内容
description.en: Business knowledge content edited by users.

description.zh: 字段名，当编辑的内容为字段时使用
description.en: The name of the field. This parameter is used when the edited content is a field.

description.zh: 物理库ID，您可以调用[SearchDatabase](~~141876~~)接口获取该值。
description.en: The ID of the physical database. You can call the [SearchDatabase](~~141876~~) operation to obtain the ID.

description.zh: 表模式名，仅当SQLServer需要传递为架构名。
description.en: The schema name of the table, which is required only for SQL Server instances.

title.zh: 编辑元数据的资产描述

descriptions.zh: 编辑指定guid代表的元数据的业务知识。
descriptions.en: Edits the business knowledge of the metadata represented by the specified GUID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dms-enterprise edit-meta-knowledge-asset --table-schema-name dbo --column-name test_column --asset-description test --db-id 19300000 --table-name table_name --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dms-enterprise EditMetaKnowledgeAsset --region cn-hangzhou --ColumnName test_column --TableName table_name --TableSchemaName dbo --AssetDescription test --DbId 19300000
